component.name: RustQuery
component.summary: A fast desktop SQL workbench for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite

description.p: RustQuery is a native desktop SQL client for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite. It combines saved connection profiles, a lazy schema explorer, multiple SQL editor tabs and a virtualised result grid in one window.

ul.li: Saved PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite connection profiles with SSL modes and connection tests.
Schema explorer for databases, tables, views, columns, indexes and foreign keys.
SQL editor with syntax highlighting, completion, undo/redo and multi-statement scripts.
Sortable, filterable result grid with full-cell inspection and CSV, JSON and SQL exports.
Transaction controls, query history, a timestamped console and four colour themes.

description.p: SQLite support is embedded. PostgreSQL and MySQL require a reachable database server at runtime.
